summary: Thin forwarding wrapper: reads the global object pointer dword_8B78A0, passes it together with the incoming this pointer and a literal zero into sub_53DB90, and returns that callee's result. No local state is touched.

operations.description: Invoke sub_53DB90 with the global dword_8B78A0 as the first argument, this as the second argument, and 0 as the third.

unresolved: The semantics of sub_53DB90 (the actual enumerator) and the meaning of its three arguments are unknown from this function alone.
dword_8B78A0 is read as a plain integer global here; whether it is an object pointer or a handle is not established.
Why the caller sub_55BE80 needs this wrapper instead of calling sub_53DB90 directly is unclear.
